rule1.title: 1. Promotion Criteria
rule1.description: Members will be upgraded upon meeting the required deposit or valid turnover for VIP advancement and will receive the corresponding level bonus. If multiple VIP level requirements are met at the same time, bonuses for all achieved levels will be granted. Bonuses can be claimed immediately upon upgrade and remain valid permanently.

rule2.title: 2. Weekly Bonus
rule2.description: Meet the weekly deposit and valid turnover requirements to receive your Weekly Bonus. Only the current level bonus is granted for multiple upgrades. Claim after 00:00:00 every Monday — unclaimed rewards expire at week’s end.

rule3.title: 3. Monthly Bonus
rule3.description: Meet the monthly deposit and valid turnover requirements to receive your Monthly Bonus. Only the current level bonus is granted for multiple upgrades. Claim after 00:00:00 on the 1st — unclaimed rewards expire at month’s end.

rule4.title: 4. Retention Requirements
rule4.description: After a VIP level change, complete the required turnover within 30 days to maintain your level. If upgraded during this time, requirements reset according to the new level.

rule5.title: 5. Demotion Criteria
rule5.description: If the required retention criteria are not met by the 30th of each month, the VIP level will be downgraded automatically, and benefits will adjust to the new level.

rule6.title: 6. Reward Expiration Policy
rule6.description: Rewards expire and become invalid after the deadline. Please claim them in time.

rule7.title: 7. Audit Policy
rule7.description: VIP bonuses require 1x turnover before withdrawal, and wagering applies to all game platforms.

rule8.title: 8. Promotion Disclaimer
rule8.description: This feature is for normal use by the account holder only. Any use of bots, scripts, exploits, or risk-free betting will result in account suspension and forfeiture of bonuses without notice.

rule9.title: 9. Right of Interpretation
rule9.description: By claiming VIP rewards, you agree to the related terms. The platform reserves the final right of interpretation.

rebateExplanation.title: Rebate Explanation :
rebateExplanation.content: Rebates are calculated based on your valid bets and applicable rebate rate. The more you bet, the more rebate you can receive.

calculationPeriod.title: Calculation Period :
calculationPeriod.content: Only valid bets placed within the recent period set by the system, such as the last 7 or 30 days, will be counted. Bets placed outside this period will be cleared automatically and will no longer be included in the rebate calculation.

claimRules.title: Claim Rules :
claimRules.content: Once your rebate amount meets the claim requirement, you may claim it. The minimum claim amount must be greater than 0.01. The actual claim method is subject to what is shown on the page.

payoutMethod.title: Payout Method :
payoutMethod.content: Rebate rewards will be credited to your account in cash. Please refer to the actual amount received.

validBetRules.title: Valid Bet Rules :
validBetRules.content: Only bets that meet the platform rules will be counted as valid bets. The following are not eligible for rebate:
items: Hedge betting or other abnormal betting behavior;
Certain promotional activities or selected games.

calculationFormula.title: Calculation Formula :
calculationFormula.content:
Rebate Amount = Valid Bets × Applicable Rebate Rate.
Rebate rates may vary by game. Please refer to the rate shown on the page.
